boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented PLNU rituals and recurring campus gatherings, from welcoming a class with beach sand to closing a fight song with the university bell.

cards.title: PLNU Sand Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Welcome Week student integration
cards.notes: At Welcome Week, add your provided beach sand to the communal tank and keep the graduation-day return of sand in view as the ritual’s bookend.
cards.short_summary: New students join a shared sand vessel; graduates receive sand back from it.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU says each student pours a vial of sand collected at local beaches into a communal tank during the Sand Ceremony and receives a vial from that tank at graduation.
cards.source_title: Traditions that Define the PLNU Student Experience
cards.access_notes: Held as part of Welcome Week; participation details are set by New Student Engagement.

cards.title: Lomaland Fair
cards.subtitle: Semester-opening campus fair
cards.notes: Use the fair as a first-week orientation stop: browse campus involvement tables and reconnect with the opening-week rhythm after the Sand Ceremony.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus fair closes Welcome Week and opens the semester for new and returning students.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU identifies the on-campus Lomaland Fair as the event that closes Welcome Week for new and returning students at the start of the semester.
cards.source_title: Traditions that Define the PLNU Student Experience
cards.access_notes: Scheduled at the start of a semester; consult current PLNU student-life announcements for date and access.

cards.title: Flex Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: Flex Apartments semester marketplace
cards.notes: Walk the Flex Apartments marketplace to see student-made goods and performances, then verify the semester’s vendor and food-truck details before attending.
cards.short_summary: A recurring student-vendor market turns the Flex Apartments into a social marketplace.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU says the Flex Farmers Market occurs every semester at the Flex Apartments and features student vendors, student-led bands, and food trucks.
cards.source_title: Traditions that Define the PLNU Student Experience
cards.access_notes: Recurring each semester; items and food are sold by vendors, while attendance arrangements may vary.

cards.title: Homecoming Chapel
cards.subtitle: Brown Chapel • Homecoming Weekend
cards.notes: Attend the Homecoming Chapel in Brown Chapel to see current students and alumni recognized together before the weekend’s other gatherings.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming worship gathering recognizes students and alumni in Brown Chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU describes Homecoming Chapel in Brown Chapel as the opening event of Homecoming festivities, where current students and alumni are recognized and celebrated.
cards.source_title: Traditions that Define the PLNU Student Experience
cards.access_notes: Part of Homecoming Weekend; consult the current Homecoming schedule for entry and timing.

cards.title: We Are Loma 5K
cards.subtitle: Homecoming Weekend • campus track and soccer field
cards.notes: Choose the race or stroll option when it is scheduled, and use the announced route rather than assuming access to athletic facilities outside the event.
cards.short_summary: Homecoming’s “We Are Loma 5K” invites participants to race or stroll on campus athletic grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU identifies the annual “We Are Loma 5K” as a Homecoming event on the university’s track and soccer field, with race and stroll options.
cards.source_title: Traditions that Define the PLNU Student Experience
cards.access_notes: Part of Homecoming Weekend; registration and route information should be confirmed in the current event listing.

cards.title: Loma Live
cards.subtitle: Greek Amphitheatre • Homecoming Weekend
cards.notes: Check the current Homecoming program for that year’s guest artist, then arrive through the designated amphitheatre entry for the concert gathering.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming concert brings a guest artist to the Greek Amphitheatre.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU lists Loma Live as a Homecoming Weekend concert at the Greek Amphitheatre featuring a guest artist each year.
cards.source_title: Traditions that Define the PLNU Student Experience
cards.access_notes: Part of Homecoming Weekend; performer, ticketing, and access can vary by year.

cards.title: Homecoming Marketplace
cards.subtitle: Homecoming Weekend vendor gathering
cards.notes: Browse the alumni and student vendor tables during Homecoming, and bring a payment method only if you intend to buy a vendor’s goods.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming vendor market highlights work from alumni and students.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU says the Homecoming Marketplace features alumni and student vendors offering items such as baked goods, homemade art, and fresh flowers.
cards.source_title: Traditions that Define the PLNU Student Experience
cards.access_notes: Part of Homecoming Weekend; vendor offerings and payment arrangements vary.

cards.title: The Green Sea
cards.subtitle: PLNU student fan tradition
cards.notes: Join the designated student-support section at an eligible game and follow current athletics and event-staff guidance for seating and participation.
cards.short_summary: The Green Sea is the named PLNU student-support tradition connected to athletic events.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU’s official student-traditions page names being part of The Green Sea among traditions shaping the student experience, and PLNU’s Viewpoint depicts it supporting teams.
cards.source_title: Traditions that Define the PLNU Student Experience
cards.access_notes: Game location and student-section procedures vary by sport and event.

cards.title: Sing “Hoist the Colors”
cards.subtitle: PLNU’s sea-shanty-style fight song
cards.notes: Learn the short call-and-response-friendly fight song before a school-spirit event, then join the group singing where organizers introduce it.
cards.short_summary: PLNU’s newer fight song uses a sea-shanty format designed for unaccompanied group voices.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU’s Viewpoint reports that the PLNU fight song, “Hoist the Colors,” was created as a sea shanty and was intended to help welcome freshmen into the PLNU community.
cards.source_title: PLNU Fight Song Creators Share the Shanty’s Origins
cards.access_notes: Used at PLNU school-spirit events; participation is event-based.

cards.title: Ring the University Bell
cards.subtitle: Orientation and commencement ritual
cards.notes: Watch for the bell moment at orientation or commencement; it follows the fight song’s closing ahoys and marks a class’s arrival or completion.
cards.short_summary: The university bell is rung to welcome a class at orientation and again at commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: PLNU’s Viewpoint identifies ringing the university bell as a tradition used to ring in a class of students at orientation and commencement, and says it caps off the fight song.
cards.source_title: PLNU Fight Song Creators Share the Shanty’s Origins
cards.access_notes: Occurs within orientation and commencement programming; follow staff direction around the bell.
